title: Development of a concept for the undercarriage of a jet propelled high altitude research aircraft.
author: Leonardo Mendes Nogueira
abstract: This work consisted on the development of a concept for the undercarriage of a jet powered, high altitude research aircraft (HARA). The aircraft is the product of a Brasil-Germany cooperation entitled UNIBRAL between the Technological Institute of Aeronautics (Instituto Tecnológico de Aeronáutica - ITA) and the Technological University of Berlin (Technische Universität Berlin - TU-Berlin). The project is funded by CAPES (Brazil) and DAAD (Germany). Along this thesis it will be show the decision making process and the academic background that gave support to it. As the project has the goal of developing a real commercial product, sellable to research institutes of Germany, Brazil and any other that poises interest, matters that are not considered in academic only work are also taking part. This has increased the value of this work as the author faced factors that are not normally issues. The result of this work can be found as two concepts that suit different possibilities of the final configuration of the aircraft. As the aircraft is being designed in a parametric way, there are many feasible outcomes. Therefore this work represents to the overall project an initial study regarding the landing gear, which was not assessed before by any of those involved in the project. Future work should take into consideration the new data being delivered by the departments (aerodynamics, flight mechanics, structure, propulsion and project) specially the information about the propulsion system, which has been a great hamper to further detailing of the undercarriage system.
